question: What is the name of India's indigenous long-range surface-to-air missile system under development, expected to be operational by 2028–29?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Project Kusha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Project Kusha** is India's indigenous long-range surface-to-air missile system currently under development by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO).
 
• The missile system is expected to be operational by **2028–29** and aims to strengthen India's air defense capabilities against threats such as enemy aircraft and missiles.
